data.body:
WHAT: ONE data table keyed by model family (claude, openai, gemini, deepseek, kimi, qwen, glm, unknown): cache kind (explicit|automatic|none), ttl options, read/write multipliers, min cacheable tokens, window, compaction kind, each fact a three-valued record (status, source, date) in the HX-facts-core shape; plus per-harness capabilities the advisor needs (can run a compaction command, which hooks accept additionalContext, usage fields in transcripts, ttl env). Run and record the probes listed in research section 11 (hooks that reach subagents, PostCompact fields, PreCompact fields, Kimi/Codex caching). REUSE: HX-facts-core (fact shape), B-am-harness-probe ([transcripts] stays there), SU-client-table (client capabilities), research/mcp-client-matrix.md. Do not edit harnesses/*.toml. WHY: model family differs from harness (Claude Code can run non-Claude models); prices move so they are dated data, never code. TEST: every harness id has a row or an explicit unknown; every fact has source and date; a fact older than [context].facts_max_age_days makes doctor note it; unverified is never read as true. ACCEPTANCE: probe record per UNVERIFIED line of research section 11.

ADDED by D-TE-Q2: include the per-agent compact-window knob table from TE-compact-window-per-agent.

Scope note (impl-cc-inventory): globs widened to the harness-capability file, the loader and the [context] section module. Wiring the section into config.py and the doctor note into api/reporting/health.py overlaps live leases (impl-governor-core, impl-review-finding): filed as follow-up CC-inventory-wire.

services/context_families.py has doctor_notes(max_age_days) and DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_DAYS=90. Add the [context] section (facts_max_age_days, four ways, knob docs), register it in config.py, and append CF.doctor_notes(cfg.context.facts_max_age_days) to doctor notes. Filed by CC-inventory because config.py and health.py were under live leases (impl-governor-core, impl-review-finding). Test: a stale fact appears in doctor output; golden snapshots, README knob table and pins regenerated.
data.title: Wire context facts: [context].facts_max_age_days knob in config.py and the doctor note in api/reporting/health.py

data.claim: PostCompact carries compact_summary; PreCompact carries custom_instructions; settings hooks fire in subagents with agent_id
data.falsifier: the hooks page lacks compact_summary on PostCompact or says subagents do not run settings hooks
data.mechanism: vendor hooks reference documents each event's input JSON
data.probe_output: PostCompact hooks receive `trigger` and `compact_summary`; PreCompact receive `trigger` and `custom_instructions`; 'Hooks from settings files... also run inside subagents ... input carries agent_id and agent_type'. Docs read, not executed; delivery of additionalContext to a subagent's model stays open (context-probes.md row 1).
data.question: Do Claude Code PostCompact/PreCompact payloads and settings hooks expose what the advisor needs (summary, instructions, subagent reach)?

evidence.note: ruff check/format clean on the new py files; roborev_branch --base main: no high/medium, 3 low findings (dead _TABLES, __file__ level counting in tests, status vocabulary in doc) all fixed in c34badc26

baseline.isolation: fresh detached worktree of the base; the project's own command ran in it, so an editable install of the branch or git-ignored fixtures can still mislead it

evidence.note: Hunted vacuous truth and silently dropped config in validate(): a row entry without `s` or with a misspelt field was ignored by facts(). Probe + regression test test_a_malformed_or_misspelt_fact_is_not_silently_dropped; mutation (disabling the not-a-fact check) makes it fail (1 failed, 10 passed), restored passes; fixed in 9034a812/e1acb3c32. Harness-id test asserts IDS is non-empty (no vacuous pass).

Searched by operation: TOML loading (infra/tomlcfg is a dataclass-overlay loader, not applicable), fact/status shapes (no other implementation; HX-facts-core unbuilt, same {status,source,date} fields), date parsing (uses core.clock.parse_date, ratchet-enforced), family names (config_sections/agent.FAMILY_HINTS maps model substrings to vendor, a different job; DRV-model-catalog will make it a reader). roborev duplicate check clean.

Correction: the earlier text wrongly cited a roborev duplicate check; none was run. What was done: searched by operation (infra/tomlcfg is a dataclass-overlay loader, not applicable; no other fact/status implementation, HX-facts-core unbuilt; dates use core.clock.parse_date; config_sections/agent.FAMILY_HINTS maps model substrings to vendors, a different job, to become a reader under DRV-model-catalog). The standards roborev review of the branch found no duplicate.
